title: Don't Starve: Invasion of shadows
description: Shadows have decided to take over the harmless world of Minecraft, but is it really that harmless?
body:
The mod is in development, and will feature chess, shadow chess, magic, and stations.

The mod adds 7 blocks:
1) Marble Block (not craftable).
2) Pottery Wheel, craftable from stone, sticks, wood, and iron, used to craft statues.
Pieces:
1) Knight
2) Bishop
3) Rook
4) Wither
5) Guardian
They are created on a potter's wheel from any white stone and a sketch.
